Attached: 1 image

Checkmate v3.13.0 is out! 📊 The open-source server and uptime monitor brings solid infrastructure tracking upgrades:

• Alerts for stopped and unhealthy Docker containers
• Incident history on public status pages
• Custom check intervals down to 10s

This update will be available soon on PikaPods!

Release: https://github.com/bluewave-labs/Checkmate/releases/tag/v3.13.0
PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=checkmate

#opensource #ownyourdata
